answer: First-seen spacing queue: each new identity’s first 20 actions are released one per 30 seconds, and any burst resets its queue. A cedar marker can tag first-seen records, binding release times to arrival order. Attackers pay at least 10 idle minutes plus queue upkeep per identity, while jade replay checks stop recycling an old arrival pattern. Ivory audit logs retain release timestamps, so resetting or faking traffic shape adds write and review overhead per identity.
